# LocaRec 0.12.0
### Added
- You can type notes while you record. Each one is stamped with the moment you started typing it and shows up as a key moment once the meeting is saved. Pressing Return on an empty line drops a plain marker, like the old Add Marker button did. If you stop recording halfway through a note, the note is kept. The menu bar has the same note field.
### Changed
- The recording page is quieter now: the title, a slim waveform and your notes, with the elapsed time and the input in use along the top. The input line names your actual microphone instead of "System Default". - The menu bar popover has the new look, and its gear button opens Settings.
### Fixed
- The recording waveform follows the sound for every input. Before, it only moved with the default microphone, and with system audio, Both or a chosen microphone it sat still. - Renaming a meeting while it's being transcribed or summarized no longer gets undone when the job finishes. The same goes for speaker fixes made while a summary is being written.
